title: oracle -- the trust plane: the oracle stack, the StackReceipt, and the verdict additions
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/oracle.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = oneOf the contract's three primary shapes: the oracle STACK (sec 3 -- library://<task_class>/stack.yaml; the manifest carries oracle.ref ONLY, ref-only per R18; frozen at run open), the StackReceipt (sec 5.1 -- the conductor-posted Medium receipt body, non-mintable SEC-3), and the verdict additions (sec 5.2). $defs also carry the canonical null: grammar (sec 12.1 -- THE one home, R17; run.md R1 copies it) and the oracle_gen kind registry (sec 5.5 -- THE one registry; wire.md 3.1 delegates here). Reader liberality: readers MUST ignore unknown fields and apply each addition's stated absent-reading (receipt without oracle.gen reads g0 forever; without failed_phase reads null; without vs_null is excluded from null-ledger folds); unknown oracle_gen kinds are preserved, never dropped.

stack.$comment: oracle.md sec 3 -- 'the oracle' is never one command: a stack of named checks with a pre-registered aggregate, a null policy per check, and per-case FAIL detail. Frozen at run open. Lives at library://<task_class>/stack.yaml; the run manifest carries oracle.ref ONLY (ref-only, R18)

protocol.$comment: score-stdout-v1 is the deprecated shim (sec 2.5): receipts marked attribution coarse; no HC-7 closure claim; new oracles MUST use report-file-v5

gen.$comment: auto = library head at run open; or pinned int. digest is NEVER authored: the runner resolves gen->digest from the registry; hand-pinned digest mismatch = apparatus INVALID

outcome.$comment: gates-lexicographic: ANY fired gate => gate, regardless of score (encodes live topology.py:184 at check level)

convergence.$comment: the trust-side predicate the run engine consumes (sec 5.3, EIGHT clauses; nothing else may declare convergence). KNOB HOMES (R18): the stack owns exactly these FIVE knobs and ONLY those. `stable_k` is a MANIFEST knob (run.md termination{}): counted by the run engine as consecutive VALID grading events with no champion improvement UNDER ONE oracle gen; gen bump resets. [R25] `null_arm` is NOT a stack knob: the null policy lives entirely in the manifest's null: block (grammar sec 12.1; $defs/null_policy)

contested_cap.$comment: regrade attempts before verified-with-residual close (sec 5.3); >= 1 (run.md R1.1 rule 6)

growth.$comment: A12 pre-registration, frozen at run open

granularity.$comment: round (answer runs) | epoch (Crucible P5) -- v2 sec 5 law

check.$comment: oracle.md sec 3 -- one named check; the property union covers the four kinds (unit: exec/grade/cases; grounding: gate/config; panel: tier/roster/blinding/controls/abstain_floor/aggregate/dissent_bound/verbosity_guard; probe: scoring/corpus/budget). A check missing on_null is a schema error (exactly three values)

required.$comment: required: INVALID after retries invalidates the whole StackReceipt (sec 2.4)

gate.$comment: gates contribute pass|gate, never a score

exec.$comment: PHASE A (TP-1): candidate execution in its sandbox over case inputs only; expected values MUST NOT enter the sandbox

driver.$comment: harness.none: prose/artifact tasks -- the declared artifact IS the behavior; no execution (repeals v1 oracle.mode judge-panel fork)

sandbox.$comment: e.g. class-3 (sec 2.1: untrusted/external/adversarial candidate code = class-3, no exceptions); isolation_actual stamped on every receipt

grade.$comment: PHASE B (TP-2): grades behavior artifacts oracle-side with no candidate code loaded; the grading channel is the report file the runner names

retries.$comment: then sec 2.3 differential re-attribution, then INVALID

config.$comment: kind=grounding: the evidence gate (A11); act-plane primitives fill the receipt evidence{} row; this contract owns gate semantics over it

mode.$comment: v2 dial; grounded mode = sampled or required; none: check absent

input.$comment: evidence-bundle: membrane-packaged at submission; packager refuses register=narrative (cite-block is cell-side, pre-oracle)

digest_check.$comment: all: every evidence ref sha256 re-verified (act-plane primitive)

witness_check.$comment: all: every act:// ref must exist in the poster's receipt history

entailment_by.$comment: cross-family-judge; a single entailment miss gates only when digest/witness corroborates, else flagged for panel

source_diversity.$comment: >= n independent domains per load-bearing claim; the CERTIFICATE reports domains-per-material-claim either way

trust_floor.$comment: optional minimum ingress trust tag (seat-10 taxonomy) for a terminal to count toward source_diversity; terminals below floor are REPORTED, never silently gating

roster.$comment: kind=panel (sec 6 JUDGE-PIPELINE): quorum-after-recusal solved at BUILD time; K counts FAMILIES, not judges

quorum.$comment: counted judges surviving recusal, PER producer family

source.$comment: pricebook weights_family column -- a TRUST input (sec 15 SEC-2: signed book + runtime canary)
library://<task_class>/controls (sec 7 TP-3: labels minted by the next-more-trusted tier only)

abstain_floor.$comment: sec 6 step 7; fabrication := 0.0 < floor by construction. THE pre-registered constant's ONE home (R20; v2's value 0.3) -- act.md sec 9 cites it, never restates

verbosity_guard.$comment: RESTORED from v2 sec 5; MUST measure, SHOULD act, MUST NOT auto-adjust scores

scoring.$comment: kind=probe: none -- NEVER contributes to score/outcome; results NEVER reach producers (zero Goodhart surface, adjudication #382)

on_null.$comment: exactly three; a check missing on_null is a schema error (sec 3 field semantics)

stack_receipt.$comment: oracle.md sec 5.1 -- the conductor-posted Medium `receipt` payload (non-mintable, SEC-3; D-gold; posting to the Medium is LAW -- the E2 fix). Wire.md 3.1: the body IS this StackReceipt verbatim and MAY carry more fields -- additionalProperties true. Reader clauses: absent oracle.gen reads g0 forever; absent failed_phase reads null; absent vs_null predates sec 12 and is excluded from null folds. Per-case detail NEVER rides the Medium receipt -- it lives behind checks[].report_ref (conductor-access-only, sec 4.2 leak constraints)

gen.$comment: int in 5.1's block; wire.md 3.1 writes the string form g3; absent reads g0 forever

digest.$comment: mismatch against the registry is tamper-evidence (sec 8.2)

outcome.$comment: exit tri-state (sec 2.4): gates dominate scores; a required check INVALID after retries invalidates the whole receipt. Spelled passed everywhere incl. wire.md 3.1 (canon #7, Outcome.passed topology.py:184); R3 reader fallback: unknown outcome reads invalid

attribution.$comment: null on passed; structural, never content inspection (sec 2.2); apparatus spend commits to the run but never charges arm.usd_spent

failed_phase.$comment: A = exec-infrastructure, B = grading apparatus (sec 2.2); null on passed; absent = pre-v5 receipt

cost.$comment: the canonical crossing-record field-group (R2/R16; pricebook.md 5.2 owns member semantics); per-arm attribution source for vs_null matched-invoice folds (R11)

wall_ms.$comment: measurement -- a SIBLING of cost{}, not a member (R16: cost{} carries dollar attribution only)

check_row.$comment: oracle.md sec 5.1 -- one per-check row on the StackReceipt; the property union covers the four kinds. The grounding evidence{} row shape is PINNED (#695) so seat 04's certificate reads one shape; report_ref artifacts are conductor-access-only

failure_signature.$comment: sha256 over sorted REPORTED failed case-ids (holdout excluded); equality prune is O(1) off the receipt (run.md R2.3)

report_ref.$comment: conductor-access-only report artifact (sec 4.2); packets carry REPORTED per-case rows only; probe results never leave the meter

evidence.$comment: grounding row, PINNED with seat 06 (#695): act-plane primitives fill it, this contract owns gate semantics

trust_floor_met.$comment: consumes seat 02/10 terminal trust tags; a low-trust terminal never silently gates (act.md 9.3)

tier.$comment: tier: screen receipts MUST NOT seat a champion, post a verdict, or trigger ejection (sec 14)

recused.$comment: runner-marked same-family scores: logged advisory, excluded from counted (sec 6 step 4)

dissent.$comment: FAMILY-level (sec 6 step 8): max over family pairs of |fam_score gap| / 10; one family among counted => contested BY FIAT

verbosity_r.$comment: spearman(counted score, candidate tokens); null until min_gradings (sec 6 step 9)

degraded.$comment: degraded panel = contested-equivalent; may rank, never seat a verified champion (sec 6 step 1)

verdict_additions.$comment: oracle.md sec 5.2 -- trust-plane (certificate-side) additions the run engine assembles onto the wire verdict body (wire.md 3.1 owns the wire discriminator `kind` and base fields champion/why/refs); additionalProperties true because it rides that body

kind.$comment: R21: the discriminator is `kind` -- wire.md 3.1's HOME enum, same spelling (5.0.0's certificate-side `type` renamed)

arm.$comment: may BE null-arm (the run still delivers)

vs_null.$comment: sec 12.3 dual-unit accounting; canonical members (R15/canon #6) = {null_score, null_usd, margin_production, margin_invoice} -- no lift_* names; null_usd is ONE member (a production/invoice split of the null's spend is render-side detail, never the wire join key). margin_invoice is the operator's unit; the flip predicate keys here (sec 12.4)

ref.$comment: sec 12.1 ref grammar: artifact://rankings/...#sha256=... (sec 5.2's example also admits medium://...)

residual.$comment: honest degradation home (sec 1.4): every mechanism that cannot run degrades to a named, certificate-visible weaker state

degraded.$comment: named degradations (sec 1.4) -- e.g. 'differential re-attribution unavailable (single-arm topology)' (sec 2.3 rule 4, s6-14)

regrades.$comment: sec 9.4: regrades are phase-B-only over cached behavior artifacts -- near-free by construction

invalid_rate.$comment: folded by the run engine; sec 2.4 R% halt input

cost.$comment: the canonical crossing-record cost{} field-group -- exactly six members (R16; pricebook.md 5.2 owns semantics). wall_ms is NOT a member: it is a sibling measurement field on the receipt

purpose.$comment: the canonical purpose enum (pricebook.md 5.2). NOTE: oracle.md sec 5.1's example prints purpose: grading, which is not in the enum -- a contract-side discrepancy flagged in the P3 fix report; judge spend rides verification per sec 2.2

oracle_gen_kind.$comment: oracle.md sec 5.5 -- THE one oracle_gen kind registry (wire.md 3.1 delegates here; canon #13). All kinds conductor-minted (SEC-3), D-gold, R-forever; unknown kinds preserved, never dropped; kind-addition is MINOR

null_policy.$comment: oracle.md sec 12.1 -- THE canonical null: grammar (R17, the ONE home; run.md R1 regenerates its null: block by COPY from here; ARCH W1 cites it). Mode is DERIVED from the class lifecycle (auto), never authored per-run; matched = v2 shape (ONE null cell, protected arm outside UCB, matched-dollar reservation at run open); floor is refused for unsettled classes. [R25] null_arm policy lives here (manifest side), never in the stack's convergence block

pin.$comment: the null's family is PRE-REGISTERED, never chosen by the machinery under audit

ref.$comment: grammar: artifact://rankings/...#sha256=... (dated external ranking, facts-with-dates style)

floor_frac.$comment: floor mode: protected reservation fraction; default 0.10

audit_rate.$comment: floor mode: fraction of runs replaying the matched null; default 0.25
